_doc: Interaction ladders for goldfish.py --disruption ladder (see docs/GOLDFISH.md, Disruption ladder). Each rung is a list of 'SLOT=code@T' events; a slot keeps its ID across rungs even when it moves earlier or upgrades. Per shuffle every slot rolls one number once; the slot fires at a rung if the roll is under p = weight(code) x intensity(rung), kept non-decreasing per slot, so a slot that fired at a rung fires at every higher rung. A trailing '!' means backed up (its own roll at backup_weight x intensity): your first answer to it gets countered. Codes: rem (removal to graveyard), rem+ (exile, targets key/tracked cards first, then highest MV), cmd, wipe, nuke (nonland wipe), nuke+gy (Farewell: exile nonland + your graveyard), rift (your nonland permanents to hand), ctr4/ctr3/ctr2 (counter your first spell of MV 4+/3+/2+ that turn, or your commander), ctrK (held from T until you cast your commander or a key/tracked card), gy (exile your graveyard), ld (destroy a land, nonbasic first), tax (noncreature spells cost 1 more, Thalia), taxall (all spells, Sphere), lock (no casting from the command zone or graveyard, Drannith). tax/taxall/lock last persist_turns of your turns or until your held removal kills them. Horizon = the turn the scripted interaction ends (games currently stop there).
